assignment.step1: 1. Choose 6 word pairs, clarifying points of phonetic similarity and difference.
assignment.step2: 2. Write activity instructions and steps for presenting each pair in a clear sequence.
assignment.step3: 3. Include a response logging template and a brief note on difficulty progression.

grades.policyTitle: How is the average calculated? — Suggested grading policy
grades.policyDesc: Each task is out of 100 points, and graded tasks carry equal weight. Total points of 522 divided by 6 tasks yields an average of 87 out of 100. Tasks under review or unsubmitted are not counted as zero and do not enter the average until evaluated.

contact.faqSubheading: Quick answers to common questions about courses, certifications, and support.
contact.faq1Q: How do I receive my certificate after completing the course?
contact.faq1A: Your digital verified certificate generates automatically on the My Certificates page once you reach at least 95% watch time and submit all required assignments.
contact.faq2Q: Can I consult directly with the speech therapist?
contact.faq2A: Yes, our courses provide interactive spaces to submit questions and receive detailed clinical feedback on your assignments from licensed supervisors.
contact.faq3Q: What are the technical requirements to watch lessons and submit tasks?
contact.faq3A: Al-Ameen runs smoothly on all modern desktop and mobile browsers without requiring any special software installations.
contact.faq4Q: Can I request a refund if I am not satisfied?
contact.faq4A: Yes, we provide a 14-day 100% money-back guarantee in accordance with our terms of service.
